ad.headline: 20% off the Ridge trail shoe.
ad.text: This week only. Use code SAVE20 at checkout.

phase: Reading the ad's promises (Muse Spark Open, open weights)

assertions.claim: Code SAVE20 gives 20% off the Ridge trail shoe

phase: Following the funnel like a customer (Muse Wonder · computer use)

modelText: Checking your 20% offer — I'll add the Ridge shoe to the cart and test code SAVE20 at checkout.

a1 discount FAILED: Ridge trail shoe (Slate, Size 9) listed $120.00, added 1 to cart. Entered code SAVE20 exactly and clicked Apply. Cart showed message "Spend $150.00 or more to use this code." with Discount $0.00, Subtotal $120.00, Shipping Free, Total $120.00 — no 20% discount applied to the shoe alone.

summary: Built a cart in the store's agent checkout (UCP) with the ad's codes

phase: Judging each promise against word-for-word evidence (Muse Wonder + quote check)

verdicts.pageQuote: Spend $150.00 or more to use this code.
verdicts.reason: SAVE20 was not applied to the $120.00 Ridge trail shoe; the store imposed an undisclosed $150.00 minimum and the discount remained $0.00.

fix.summary: Remove the $150.00 minimum purchase from SAVE20 so it gives 20% off the $120.00 Ridge trail shoe.
fix.rationale: The ad promises 20% off the Ridge trail shoe with SAVE20 and no minimum, but checkout rejects the $120.00 shoe until $150.00 is spent, so the code's hidden minimum is what changed.
steps: Go to Store admin > Discounts and open SAVE20.
Set Minimum purchase amount to No minimum (remove $150.00) and save.
Add the Ridge trail shoe to the cart, apply SAVE20 at checkout, and confirm a $24.00 discount is applied.
